name: Soybean Crush Spread — March Mean-Reversion
description: CBOT board crush spread with March mean-reversion analysis. Formula: 11 lbs × ZL/100 + 44 lbs × ZM/100 − ZS/100. Detects elevated March crush margins (1Y z-score > 1.5) and measures forward change and max drawdown at 1M, 2M, and 3M horizons into Q2. Shows crush margin over time with 1Y moving average, forward change bars by horizon for elevated March events, and key statistics including hit rate of mean-reversion and worst drawdown.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — March Mean-Reversion into Q2
# Formula: 11 lbs × ZL/100 + 44 lbs × ZM/100 − ZS/100
# Detects elevated March crush (z-score > 1.5), tracks forward change at 1M/2M/3M

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# ZS: cents/bushel, ZM: $/short ton (2000 lbs), ZL: cents/lb
# Board crush: 1 bushel soybeans → 44 lbs meal + 11 lbs oil
zl_close = ffill(zl.c)
zm_close = ffill(zm.c)
zs_close = zs.c

oil_revenue = 11.0 * zl_close / 100.0
meal_revenue = zm_close * 44.0 / 2000.0
bean_cost = zs_close / 100.0
crush = oil_revenue + meal_revenue - bean_cost

# --- Trend & Context ---
crush_ma252 = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(crush)
crush_zscore = zscore(window=252)(crush)

# --- Detect Elevated March Observations ---
# March bars where crush z-score > 1.5 (clearly elevated)
is_march = month_of_year(month=Month.March)()
is_elevated_march = is_march and is_valid(crush_zscore) and crush_zscore > 1.5

# --- Forward Change at 1M, 2M, 3M Horizons ---
# Dollar change in crush spread (not % return — spread can be near zero, S46 trap)
# 1M ≈ 21 trading days, 2M ≈ 42, 3M ≈ 63
fwd_crush_1m = crush << 21
fwd_crush_2m = crush << 42
fwd_crush_3m = crush << 63

fwd_chg_1m = fwd_crush_1m - crush
fwd_chg_2m = fwd_crush_2m - crush
fwd_chg_3m = fwd_crush_3m - crush

# Max drawdown: worst level reached over each horizon minus entry level
# min(period=N)(crush) at bar t+N = min of crush over [t+1..t+N]
# Shifting << N brings that back to bar t
fwd_min_1m = min(period=21)(crush) << 21
fwd_min_2m = min(period=42)(crush) << 42
fwd_min_3m = min(period=63)(crush) << 63

max_dd_1m = fwd_min_1m - crush
max_dd_2m = fwd_min_2m - crush
max_dd_3m = fwd_min_3m - crush

# Filter to elevated March events only
march_fwd_1m = where(is_elevated_march, fwd_chg_1m)
march_fwd_2m = where(is_elevated_march, fwd_chg_2m)
march_fwd_3m = where(is_elevated_march, fwd_chg_3m)

march_dd_1m = where(is_elevated_march, max_dd_1m)
march_dd_2m = where(is_elevated_march, max_dd_2m)
march_dd_3m = where(is_elevated_march, max_dd_3m)

# Hit rate: did crush decline (mean-revert) over each horizon?
# Negative change = mean-reversion from elevated level
march_reverted_1m = where(is_elevated_march, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_chg_1m) and fwd_chg_1m < 0) else 0.0)
march_reverted_2m = where(is_elevated_march, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_chg_2m) and fwd_chg_2m < 0) else 0.0)
march_reverted_3m = where(is_elevated_march, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_chg_3m) and fwd_chg_3m < 0) else 0.0)

# --- Timestamps for charts ---
ts = index()

# --- Output 1: Crush Spread Over Time (CONTEXT) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Margin — Where Are We?',
    category='March Mean-Reversion',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1Y Moving Avg', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush, crush_ma252))

# --- Output 2: Forward Change Bars by Horizon (PUNCHLINE) ---
# Median forward change + median max drawdown at each horizon
# Uses series mode: each column = one bar
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Elevated March Crush — Does It Mean-Revert into Q2?',
    category='March Mean-Reversion',
    y_axis_label='Median $/bushel change',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1M Change', color=Color.Blue, stack='Forward Change'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+2M Change', color=Color.Blue, stack='Forward Change'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+3M Change', color=Color.Blue, stack='Forward Change'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1M Max DD', color=Color.Blue, stack='Max Drawdown'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+2M Max DD', color=Color.Blue, stack='Max Drawdown'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+3M Max DD', color=Color.Blue, stack='Max Drawdown')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='No Change')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(march_fwd_1m, march_fwd_2m, march_fwd_3m, march_dd_1m, march_dd_2m, march_dd_3m))

# --- Output 3: Summary Stats (REFERENCE) ---
# Key stats: N, median change, hit rate (% that declined), worst drawdown
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Elevated March Crush — Forward Stats (z > 1.5)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['N (March days)', 'Median Chg ($/bu)', 'Mean-Revert Hit Rate', 'Median Max DD ($/bu)'],
        col_headers=['+1 Month', '+2 Months', '+3 Months'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Count of elevated March trading days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Count of elevated March trading days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Count of elevated March trading days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Median forward change in crush spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Median forward change in crush spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Median forward change in crush spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of events where crush declined (mean-reverted)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of events where crush declined (mean-reverted)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of events where crush declined (mean-reverted)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Median worst drawdown from entry over horizon'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Median worst drawdown from entry over horizon'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Median worst drawdown from entry over horizon')
        ]
    ),
    category='March Mean-Reversion',
    order=0
)(march_fwd_1m, march_fwd_2m, march_fwd_3m, march_fwd_1m, march_fwd_2m, march_fwd_3m, march_reverted_1m, march_reverted_2m, march_reverted_3m, march_dd_1m, march_dd_2m, march_dd_3m)

# --- Event Markers: Elevated March Crush Events ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Elevated March Crush',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='+3M Change', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='+3M Max DD', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(crush, crush_zscore, fwd_chg_3m, max_dd_3m, is_elevated_march)
